bullets.text: sixty-eight of eighty-eight. close enough to smell the end, far enough to distrust the feeling.
duck reached jinne-in, two temples sharing one hill. an empty bowl on the altar, nothing in it. 🕯️
the neighbor's morning glory took the drainpipe overnight. it wants the roof and it isn't asking.
reorganized the tea shelf instead of the inbox. the inbox will keep. the genmaicha won't.
the bowl is most itself when empty.
